items.title: Jane Bunnett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 25, 2024
items.q: Yeah. Hendricks and Ross, Annie Ross.

ctx.x: Yeah. Hendricks and Ross, Annie Ross. And I remember saying, “Wow I really love this record, Joni Mitchell sings like “My analyst told me” and the two guys that ran the store just looked at me like they just wanted to toss me out the place.
